sparsity.description: Reported in trained BDH: roughly 5% of neurons active, non-negative, activity varies with predictability — not a fixed budget.

not_an_ssm: Do not classify BDH as an SSM in the Mamba sense. BDH-GPU is ReLU-low-rank transformations with linear attention.
